global: This shoyu ramen features a rich, amber broth with tender chashu pork and a single nori sheet resting atop. Served in a white bowl with a spoon, it sits on a wooden table under warm, inviting light.

regions.background: Light brown wooden table with visible grain patterns and smooth surface texture.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, red-brown rim edge.
regions.soup: The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is golden-brown, glossy, and contains visible noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
regions.spoon: A white ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface and slightly curved, tapered shape.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, rectangular, with visible surface details and slight curling edges.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows tender, marbled texture with light brown exterior and pale pink interior, irregularly shaped.
